args.subject: Missing receipt: taxi 3 Oct 2026 (Rp230.000) — claim CLM-2026-0110
args.body:
Hi Rina,

We are reviewing claim CLM-2026-0110 (trip Jakarta–Surabaya, 2–4 Oct 2026). One item is missing its supporting document:

- 3 Oct 2026, taxi hotel to client office and back, Rp230.000 — no receipt attached.

Taxi is a receipt-required category, so we cannot reimburse it without one. Could you forward the receipt (struk/kuitansi or e-receipt from the taxi app) to reimburse@ with the subject line unchanged?

Everything else on the claim is progressing. Thanks!

Finance / Claim Audit

args.query: taxi receipt struk kuitansi reimburse 3 Oct
